scope: seven visual categories only; technical category 8 deferred to fresh independent technical evidence
method_note: Beauty images establish atmosphere and finish. Cutaways are used only to audit construction/layout evidence and do not substitute for enclosed player-view beauty assessment. Shape scoring considers primary and secondary constructed angular forms as rendered; tertiary detail quantity does not raise the score by itself.

evidence: C02_HERO_DOCK: central yellow route markings lead cleanly through the scanner, but auxiliary branches end at the check-in window and cargo/equipment zones without equally clear route hierarchy.
C06_CART_GATE_G1: the low sliding bypass panels and broad header dominate the right half of the approach and reduce the legibility of the path behind them.
deductions.repair: Differentiate the staff, pedestrian and cart routes with a small number of consistent floor cues; reduce the bypass assembly's visual competition with the walking route.

evidence: PLAYER_PINCH: the camera-height view confirms a narrow-feeling return beside the gate, although the route remains visually passable.
deductions.repair: Check the cart gate and adjacent equipment silhouettes against the intended walkable width; preserve a visibly continuous pedestrian clearance.

categories.name: Grounded stylized shape language and object-specific construction

evidence: C02_HERO_DOCK and C04_SCANNER_APPROACH: the scanner is a clear, angular portal with attached control details, but its dominant silhouette remains a squared frame with largely flat uprights and a flat cap.

C05_CONVEYOR_LEAD_TUNNEL and HERO_CARGO: the cargo inspection tunnel and crate have identifiable functional construction, yet their large masses rely on rectilinear shells and repeated inset rectangular panels.
HERO_UTILITIES: the three wall units share near-identical box proportions and panel treatment despite representing different electrical/data functions.
deductions.repair: Give the scanner uprights and cap a more specific manufactured section; vary the cargo-shell profile and access construction; distinguish the data, alarm and switch enclosures through their primary forms and mounting logic before adding small detail.

evidence: C03_CHECKIN_COUNTER and DETAIL_CHECKIN: counter, hatch, desk and nearby housings repeat broad rectangular planes with limited depth changes; the check-in assembly is cleanly made but not strongly authored as a unique civic-industrial fixture.
deductions.repair: Develop a distinctive counter/hatch cross-section with a readable service lip, document handoff zone and staff-side construction, keeping the current restrained scale.

categories.name: Inspection/check-in hero hierarchy and functional composition

evidence: C02_HERO_DOCK: the counter occupies a large left foreground mass while scanner, cargo line and gate compete across the center/right; the main task order is understandable but not immediate at first glance.
C05_CONVEYOR_LEAD_TUNNEL: the crate hides much of the tunnel's lower mechanism and the key inspection aperture reads as a dark slot.
deductions.repair: Strengthen the visual handoff from check-in to personnel scan to cargo inspection with controlled light and clearer functional separation; expose enough of the cargo mechanism to read its operation.

evidence: C03_CHECKIN_COUNTER: the desk props and intercom imply check-in, but the visitor-facing document exchange and staff control zone have similar visual emphasis.
deductions.repair: Use placement and value grouping to make the document handoff and staff control point read in a single glance.

categories.name: Tactile material identity and UV/texture discipline

evidence: C01_ENTRY and C02_HERO_DOCK: painted wall, dark trim, steel-blue machinery and floor are separated by value and roughness, but many broad painted-metal and structural surfaces still resolve as similarly smooth, uniform shader fields.
HERO_TROLLEY: the cover reads as fabric through its drape and matte response, while the straps and frame have only modest material separation at this view size.
deductions.repair: Add restrained broad roughness/value variation to selected painted metal and flooring; sharpen rubber/metal/fabric response differences on trolley and equipment without adding noisy scratches.

evidence: C05_CONVEYOR_LEAD_TUNNEL and HERO_UTILITIES in UV-standard: checker scale is broadly controlled, but many separate components show similarly sized checker cells, leaving small-object texel density and seams difficult to distinguish visually.
deductions.repair: Review a few representative large and small surfaces for consistent texel density and hidden seam placement; avoid treating the checker render as proof of production texture quality.

categories.name: Localized lighting, depth and bleak atmosphere without hiding geometry

evidence: C05_CONVEYOR_LEAD_TUNNEL: the inspection tunnel's interior and lower conveyor mechanism fall into near-black shadow; the cargo detail view loses construction information at the exact functional focal point.
C08_CONCEALED_SUPPORT_H1 and HERO_TROLLEY: the isolated trolley pool is atmospheric, but its rear support and evidence storage merge into dark wall/furniture values.
deductions.repair: Raise local fill or bounce within the cargo tunnel and add restrained separation to the concealed support bay so the geometry stays legible while preserving darker peripheral zones.

evidence: C02_HERO_DOCK and C10_ROOF_SERVICES: practical lights establish warm pools, but dark ceiling structure occupies a large continuous band and leaves the room's upper volume visually compressed.
deductions.repair: Clarify the ceiling depth with selective reflected fill and value separation between beams, services and background; keep fixtures as practical sources rather than bright decoration.

categories.name: Approved spawn colour coherence and restrained accents

evidence: C02_HERO_DOCK compared with approved VALIDATE_Spawn and VALIDATE_LockerDoor: the dock carries the same warm wall/cool dark-blue structure/orange accent logic, but its large mauve-pink wall fields shift the dominant warm hue away from the spawn room's burnt orange and cream.
deductions.repair: Bring a few major wall or architectural fields closer to the approved warm neutral/orange family while retaining the dock's cooler blue machinery and limited orange safety accents.

evidence: C01_ENTRY and C02_HERO_DOCK: orange floor lanes, scanner header, gate signs and machinery panels repeat across many focal points, slightly flattening the accent hierarchy.
deductions.repair: Reserve the strongest orange for safety routes, active inspection points and a few institutional identifiers; reduce it on secondary machine panels.

categories.name: Purposeful worker traces and coercive institutional storytelling

evidence: C07_OFFICE_INTERIOR: the 'M. VALE / 14 HOURS / NO RELIEF' board is a specific human trace and the paperwork supports work-in-progress, but much of the surrounding office wall and floor is empty.

C08_CONCEALED_SUPPORT_H1 and HERO_TROLLEY: the covered trolley and tagged cabinet convey evidence custody and concealment, though the uniformly spaced straps and tidy placement make the bay feel staged rather than under pressure.
deductions.repair: Add one or two purposeful signs of recent handling, interrupted work or hurried custody transfer, tied to the existing narrative rather than general clutter.

evidence: C02_HERO_DOCK and WALL_OFFICE_FRONT: 'WE VALUE YOUR TIME', 'ALL DELAYS ARE YOUR RESPONSIBILITY' and 'YOUR WORK MATTERS' establish coercive corporate language, but remain poster-like statements without a strong visual contradiction in their immediate surroundings.
deductions.repair: Pair the reassurance language with a nearby concrete consequence or procedural contradiction, using a small, readable artifact rather than more wall copy.

evidence: C01_ENTRY and C09_ARRIVAL_GATE_P2: signage is legible at its intended distance but several small labels read as generic equipment naming rather than dock-specific operating procedure.
deductions.repair: Use a few dock-specific labels that explain custody, delay or conditional release; remove generic labels that do not advance function or story.

honest_limitations: This is a pixel-based visual review of the specified image sets and four approved spawn references.
The UV follow set is a checker diagnostic; it does not prove final texture bake quality or native UV integrity.
This review does not certify geometry clearances, support contact, normals, dependency portability, cold-start reproducibility, runtime readability or performance.
No native scene, builder code, earlier reviews, previous scores, or other visual critic result was used for these visual judgements.
